name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.RoundedAudit.strict_literal_entropy_budget
title: Strict serialization bounds the adaptive entropy term even with initial leakage
statement: For the literal 128-parameter header format the strict 32-bit exponent budget allows at most 18053 fresh responses. Even with 15000 bits of initial leakage the integer upper bound for the bad-pair term remains below two to the minus 540 after normalization by the source count.
